business_summary: Xinlei Compressor Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of air compressors, blowers, and other aerodynamic equipment in China and internationally. The company offers screw air compressors, including oil-, air-, and water-cooled series products, as well as oil-free screw blowers; heating, ventilation, and AC products, including magnetic levitation variable frequency centrifugal chillers, XLSC series screw heat pump units, air source heat pump air conditioners, maglev centrifugal heat pumps for farming applications, MRC series magnetic centrifugal refrigeration compressors, SCD series single-unit two-stage screw refrigeration compressors, and ultra-low ambient temperature air source screw heat pump units; and high-speed permanent magnet centrifugal machines, such as air and magnetic suspension centrifugal blowers, magnetic levitation centrifugal vacuum pumps and compressors, permanent magnet variable frequency centrifugal blowers and vacuum pumps, and high-speed aerators. It also provides car-mounted air compressors; piston air compressors, such as oil-free air compressors and permanent magnet frequency conversion energy-saving piston machines; and OEM products, including permanent magnet, two-stage permanent magnet, fixed speed, super energy single-phase/three-phase, and all-in-one screw air compressors. In addition, the company offers solutions for the industrial field, which include sewage treatment, precision electronics, thermoelectricity, cement, petrochemical industry, mining, food, textile, automobile manufacturing, papermaking, printing and dyeing, and biological fermentation; agriculture, forestry, and fishing, including cultivation and plantation; and HVAC engineering, such as refrigeration, heating, drying, and heating. Further, it engages in contract energy management, installation, and investment services. The company exports its products. Xinlei Compressor Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Taizhou, China.
